breakdown.description: The inward normal pressure on the arc is replaced by a fixed vertical traction vector
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed to model the load as a uniform vertical traction. The ground truth corrected this to be an inward normal pressure. The generated specification repeated the error, stating to 'Apply a vertical downward traction of (0, -20e3) Pa on the curved boundary'.
